title: Fire Mountain
subtitle: The light we share
opening: Above the cleared rockslide, Fire Mountain glows red. Emberwing curls around an egg while black vines tighten around the Heart Crystal.
ending: The Heart Crystal shines in its cradle. The pools sing, the cave crystals ring, the snow sparkles, and the unicorns run free. Emberwing’s hatchling opens its eyes. Liza is the Keeper of the Heartlight.
not_yet: That place is resting. Follow the glowing landmark on your quest card.

steps.title: The dragon who needed help
steps.speaker: Emberwing
steps.clue: Please stay back! My egg was cold, so I asked Pip for the crystal. But these vines grew around it. Now I cannot let go. I do not want to hurt anyone.

steps.title: The three forgotten signs
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: Every landmark kept a piece of this mystery. Find the Pool Mark at the Moon Crystal, the Forest Mark at the Elder Tree, and the Cave Mark at the Treasure Chest. Bring them back together.

steps.title: The Heartglow spell
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: The signs fit together! The Heart Crystal shares light; it cannot make light alone. Heartglow follows the kindness joining every living thing. You have been learning it all along.

steps.title: The Black Briar’s secret
steps.speaker: Black Briar
steps.clue: I took the crystal’s light for myself. Without a way home, it grew into me: the Black Briar. Your little spells cannot untangle a whole mountain!

steps.title: A road through the roots
steps.speaker: Good Witch Willow
steps.clue: At the Elder Tree, use Wayweave to open a path through the roots. Willow holds the road steady while you travel.

steps.title: Cool the burning stones
steps.speaker: Frost Queen Orielle
steps.clue: At the Moon Crystal, use Frostbind to cool the stones around Emberwing’s egg. Queen Orielle keeps the cold gentle.

steps.title: Untangle the Heart Crystal
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: Follow the light: Treasure Chest, Moon Crystal, Elder Tree. Then repeat that journey. Every wave loosens one of the six briar knots. We will wait while you travel.

steps.title: Warmth that can be shared
steps.speaker: Emberwing
steps.clue: The vines are falling away! My egg is warm because you stayed to help me. It needs my warmth, not a stolen crystal. Please, Liza. Take the Heart Crystal home.

steps.title: The crystal comes free
steps.speaker: Pip
steps.clue: Visit the Treasure Chest. Use Glowmend to lift the Heart Crystal without breaking its cradle. Pip is holding the basket open for you.

steps.title: Carry the light home
steps.clue: Moon Crystal, Elder Tree, Treasure Chest. Share Heartglow with every landmark. The crystal returns to the pools, and a new Heart Seed begins to grow.
steps.speaker: Luma

steps.title: Liza, Keeper of the Heartlight
steps.speaker: Luma
steps.clue: You healed the fairies. You listened to Pip. You solved the queen’s riddle and freed the unicorns. You helped a frightened dragon. The realm is bright because you shared your light. This is your story, Liza.
